prompts.cat: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production desktop pet animation sprite atlas. Use the attached atlas ONLY as the character identity and watercolor drawing style reference, not as layout. Generate a NEW SIX-frame seamless music animation sheet, EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells, landscape 1536x1024. Reading order left-to-right top row then bottom row. Same character, face, proportions, outfit, camera and scale across all six frames. Fine warm brown pencil outlines and delicate Japanese healing manga watercolor, soft adorable expression. Obvious padded over-ear HEADPHONES with headband in EVERY frame. Six progressive poses in ONE continuous rhythmic loop; frame6 leads naturally to frame1, no identical repeated pose. Keep whole character including ears, tail, headphones and tiny music notes within central75% of each cell with generous transparent gutters on all sides. Fixed feet baseline at84% of each cell; no cropping or touching adjacent frames. Actual alpha transparent background, no backdrop, no checkerboard, no grid, no labels, no text, no logo. Same orange-and-white fluffy kitten. Mint and cream headphones, cat ears still visible. Standing upright on hind paws doing a cute dance: 1 gentle center bounce,2 lean left raise right front paw,3 leftward sway tail curves right,4 center bounce paws open,5 lean right raise left front paw,6 rightward sway tail curves left. Alternate little foot lifts, happy closed eyes and smile, a couple tiny musical notes near head. No bowl.
